description: Aider-polyglot style (Kotlin): find a closed chain through all dominoes, each of which may be flipped, from a stub and an instructions file. Rule twist against the textbook exercise: the chain must start with the first input domino, so a first domino outside the only ring gives null even though a ring exists. Also covers the empty input, a lone double, duplicates and dead ends that need backtracking. A plain Kotlin test runner compiled by run_tests.py is the acceptance bar and the post-turn verifier runs it for a repair round.
